arm_groups.label: Forxiga® + Glifage XR® + Placebo of Januvia®
Januvia® + Glifage XR® + Placebo of Forxiga®

brief_summary: The present study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of different combinations of oral antidiabetics in patients with inadequate glycemic control on metformin monotherapy.
brief_title: iSGLT2 Inhibitor and a iDPP -4 Inhibitor in Treatment of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus in Patients Treated With Metformin (TRIAD)
official_title: Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of the Combined Use of a Sodium-glucose Cotransporter 2 (iSGLT2) Inhibitor and a Dipeptidyl Peptidase-4 (iDPP -4) Inhibitor in the Treatment of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus in Patients Treated With Metformin

primary_outcomes.measure: Evaluate the glycemic control at week 16
